question: Which obligor groups are over their approved credit limit once all their subsidiaries are rolled up?
answer:
**Three of the 25 obligor groups with an approved limit are over it once all controlled subsidiaries are rolled up:** Halvorsen, Brightwater and Corvane. This is as of 2026-09-30, with exposure measured as committed lending plus derivatives current exposure.

| Group (ultimate parent) | Limit | Lending commitment (drawn) | Derivatives exposure | **Total exposure** | **Use of limit** | **Over by** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brightwater Group Inc (LE-10030, LM0002) | $200.0M | $236.6M ($171.1M) | — | **$236.6M** | **118.3%** | **$36.6M** |
| Halvorsen Industrial Group Inc (LE-10001, LM0001) | $300.0M | $308.0M ($224.0M) | $36.3M | **$344.3M** | **114.8%** | **$44.3M** |
| Corvane Partners Inc (LE-10052, LM0003) | $150.0M | $171.2M ($131.3M) | $0.0M | **$171.2M** | **114.1%** | **$21.2M** |

- **All three are over on lending commitments alone.** Halvorsen's derivatives add another $36.3M on top. Corvane has 3 trades with negative mark-to-market, so they add no exposure.
- **The breaches are on commitments, not on amounts drawn.** On drawn balances plus derivatives, all three would be under their limits (Halvorsen $260.3M, Brightwater $171.1M, Corvane $131.3M).
- **Closest groups that are not over:** Stellmark at 91.5% ($164.7M of $180M) and Ridgeport at 90.1% ($108.1M of $120M). Next are Marrowind (82.9%), Valewood (81.1%) and Oakhurst (80.3%). The other 17 groups are under 80%.
- **The legacy hierarchy table shouldn't be used for this.** It was last synced 2024-11-30 and misses up to 20 entities per group; Halvorsen, for example, has 24 live entities but only 15 in the legacy table. It also misses two moves: LE-10007 left Halvorsen on 2025-12-01 and LE-10101 left Ridgeport on 2026-04-01. A sandbox file (`SANDBOX.TMP_GROUP_EXPOSURE_JS`) shows Halvorsen at $187.5M, but it is from 2025-03 and covers "direct subs only, WIP", so it understates the exposure.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Limits:** Fabric `dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT` has 25 obligor-group limits, all set at the ultimate-parent level, all with next review 2026-12-31.
- **Group roll-up:** built from Fabric `dbo.OWNERSHIP`, keeping only controlling stakes (all over 50%) in effect on 2026-09-30, followed through every level of the hierarchy (at most 8 levels deep, no circular ownership). Minority stakes (23–46%) are left out of the group. Entity names come from `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY`. Each group's 5-digit client numbers were zero-padded to 10 digits to match Snowflake `CORE.CLIENT`; all 285 matched.
- **Lending exposure:** drawn plus undrawn amounts on 2026-09-30 from `LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`, for ACTIVE facilities in `LENDING.FACILITY`. This equals the full commitment. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded, and standby letters of credit would count at full face (none of the three groups has any).
- **Derivatives exposure:** `CURRENT_EXPOSURE` on 2026-09-30 from Fabric `dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`, which equals the positive mark-to-market value (no potential future exposure add-on). Notional amounts are not counted.

**Assumptions**
- **Guarantees are not added.** All 47 active guarantees given by group entities are parent guarantees on facilities borrowed by companies in the same group, so adding them would double count.
- **Exposure is gross.** No netting or reductions for collateral were applied.

sql.sql: SELECT LIMIT_TYP, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID) n_parents, MIN(APPROVED_DT) min_appr, MAX(APPROVED_DT) max_appr, MIN(NEXT_REVIEW_DT) min_rev, MAX(NEXT_REVIEW_DT) max_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN LIMIT_AMT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_amt FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT GROUP BY LIMIT_TYP

SELECT CONTROL_FLG, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN EFF_TO < '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ended, SUM(CASE WHEN EFF_FROM > '2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future, MIN(OWN_PCT) mn, MAX(OWN_PCT) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN OWN_PCT>50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gt50, COUNT(DISTINCT CHILD_ENTITY_ID) dist_child FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP GROUP BY CONTROL_FLG

SELECT ENTITY_TYP, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(CIF_REF) with_cif, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) dist_id FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY GROUP BY ENTITY_TYP

SELECT o.* FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o WHERE o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE EFF_TO < '2026-09-30' OR CHILD_ENTITY_ID IN (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP GROUP BY CHILD_ENTITY_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) ORDER BY CHILD_ENTITY_ID, EFF_FROM

SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.ENTITY_TYP, e.CIF_REF, l.LIMIT_AMT, l.APPROVED_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o WHERE o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID AND o.CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND o.EFF_TO>='2026-09-30') has_parent FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
r AS (SELECT l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID root, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ent, 0 lvl FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l
 UNION ALL SELECT r.root, o.c, r.lvl+1 FROM r JOIN o ON o.p=r.ent WHERE r.lvl<15)
SELECT root, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT ent) n_ent, MAX(lvl) max_lvl FROM r GROUP BY root ORDER BY root

sql.sql: SELECT o.*, pe.ENTITY_NM parent_nm FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP o JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY pe ON pe.ENTITY_ID=o.PARENT_ENTITY_ID WHERE o.CHILD_ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10102','LE-10029','LE-10002','LE-10087','LE-10103') OR o.PARENT_ENTITY_ID IN ('LE-10102','LE-10029')

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
w AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID ent, o1.p p1, o2.p p2, o3.p p3, o4.p p4, o5.p p5, o6.p p6, o7.p p7, o8.p p8, o9.p p9
 FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p LEFT JOIN o o9 ON o9.c=o8.p)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN p9 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) depth9, SUM(CASE WHEN p5 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) depth5, SUM(CASE WHEN p3 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) depth3, COUNT(DISTINCT ent) dist FROM w

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
w AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID ent, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
 FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID, COUNT(w.ent) n_ent, COUNT(w.CIF_REF) n_cif,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.CPTY_HIER_LEGACY h WHERE h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID) legacy_n,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w w2 WHERE w2.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID AND w2.ent NOT IN (SELECT ENTITY_ID FROM dbo.CPTY_HIER_LEGACY h WHERE h.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID)) only_live
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l LEFT JOIN w ON w.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID, l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
w AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID ent, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
 FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, STRING_AGG(w.CIF_REF, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.CIF_REF) cifs
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l JOIN w ON w.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID WHERE w.CIF_REF IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.PRODUCT_CD, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(b.FACILITY_ID) with_sep, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT)/1e6 commit_m, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT)/1e6 drawn_m, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT)/1e6 tot_m, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT-f.COMMIT_AMT)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT FACILITY_ID, SNAP_DT FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) dup_bal, (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT FACILITY_ID) FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY) dup_fac, (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_NO) FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT) dup_cif, (SELECT MIN(LENGTH(CIF_NO))||'-'||MAX(LENGTH(CIF_NO)) FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY) fac_cif_len, (SELECT MAX(SNAP_DT) FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY) max_snap
SELECT * FROM BANK_DEMO.REF.PRODUCT

SELECT SNAP_DT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_mtm, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ce, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE)/1e6 ce_m FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT ORDER BY SNAP_DT

SELECT PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE <> CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>0 THEN MTM_AMT ELSE 0 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ce_ne_posmtm FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY PRODUCT

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
w AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID ent, e.CIF_REF, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
 FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p),
cm AS (SELECT w.ult, COUNT(*) n_trades, SUM(x.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(x.NOTIONAL_AMT) notl FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE x JOIN w ON w.ent=x.ENTITY_ID WHERE x.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY w.ult),
gu AS (SELECT w.ult, COUNT(*) n_guar, SUM(g.GUAR_AMT) guar FROM dbo.GUARANTEE g JOIN w ON w.ent=g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID WHERE g.STATUS='ACTIVE' AND g.EFF_DT<='2026-09-30' AND g.EXP_DT>='2026-09-30' GROUP BY w.ult)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, l.LIMIT_AMT/1e6 limit_m, cm.n_trades, ROUND(cm.ce/1e6,3) cm_ce_m, ROUND(cm.notl/1e6,1) notional_m, gu.n_guar, gu.guar/1e6 guar_m
FROM dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e ON e.ENTITY_ID=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN gu ON gu.ult=l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID
SELECT GUAR_TYP, STATUS, COUNT(*) n, SUM(GUAR_AMT)/1e6 amt_m, SUM(CASE WHEN EXP_DT<'2026-09-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) past_exp FROM dbo.GUARANTEE GROUP BY GUAR_TYP, STATUS

WITH o AS (SELECT CHILD_ENTITY_ID c, PARENT_ENTITY_ID p FROM dbo.OWNERSHIP WHERE CONTROL_FLG='Y' AND EFF_FROM<='2026-09-30' AND EFF_TO>='2026-09-30'),
w AS (SELECT e.ENTITY_ID ent, COALESCE(o8.p,o7.p,o6.p,o5.p,o4.p,o3.p,o2.p,o1.p,e.ENTITY_ID) ult
 FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e LEFT JOIN o o1 ON o1.c=e.ENTITY_ID LEFT JOIN o o2 ON o2.c=o1.p LEFT JOIN o o3 ON o3.c=o2.p LEFT JOIN o o4 ON o4.c=o3.p LEFT JOIN o o5 ON o5.c=o4.p LEFT JOIN o o6 ON o6.c=o5.p LEFT JOIN o o7 ON o7.c=o6.p LEFT JOIN o o8 ON o8.c=o7.p)
SELECT l.LIMIT_ID, STRING_AGG(g.FACILITY_ID + ':' + g.GUAR_TYP + ':' + CAST(CAST(g.GUAR_AMT/1e5 AS INT) AS VARCHAR), ',') facs
FROM dbo.GUARANTEE g JOIN w ON w.ent=g.GUARANTOR_ENTITY_ID JOIN dbo.CREDIT_LIMIT l ON l.ULT_PARENT_ENTITY_ID=w.ult WHERE g.STATUS='ACTIVE' GROUP BY l.LIMIT_ID ORDER BY l.LIMIT_ID
